name: Celestial Prowess adds 5/10% crit to Lunar Lance and Starfire Shot (#2043)
contract: Celestial Prowess 561206 (rank 1) and 561344 (rank 2) (Spell.dbc, family 32) tooltip: "Increases the critical strike chance of Lunar Lance and Starfire Shot by $s1%." Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107), EffectMiscValue SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE (7), EffectBasePoints 4 and 9 with DieSides 1 (=5 and 10), EffectSpellClassMask (0x800, 0x02000000, 0x100), which matches Starfire Shot ranks (word0 0x800), Starfire Barrage 802682 (word0 0x800) and Lunar Lance ranks (word1 0x02000000). Native path: Unit::SpellDoneCritChance ends with modOwner->ApplySpellMod(spell, SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE, crit_chance) for every damage class. Lunar Lance 502340 has Effect 0 SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE, so IsCritCapable is true and the harness spell_done_crit_chance metric (SpellDoneCritChance with the spell's school) returns crit% including the modifier; the control shares race, class and level, so the difference must be exactly 5 for rank 1 and 10 for rank 2 (one rank learned per fixture). spell_modifier op 7 on base 0 gives the raw modifier for Starfire Shot and Starfire Barrage, whose Effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_NORMALIZED_WEAPON_DMG (121), while Scattered Star (word0 0x800000, word1 0x800) is the negative control. Values read 2026-09-21 from the shipped /srv/coa/server-data/dbc/Spell.dbc.
